description:
Configure the 'SimpleNotes' Android app to accept text shared from other applications. 

Starting with the provided project:
1. Modify `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` to add an `<intent-filter>` to the MainActivity that accepts `android.intent.action.SEND` with a MIME type of `text/plain`.
2. Update `app/src/main/java/com/example/simplenotes/MainActivity.kt` to handle the incoming intent. If the activity is started with a SEND action and text content, extract the text using `Intent.EXTRA_TEXT` and display it in the `noteInput` EditText.
3. Ensure the project builds successfully.
